$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A Wi-Fi access point, or a router that has Wi-Fi: the Wi-Fi network, the device's identifiers, and the admin login of its web interface. serial_number and MAC are listed here again on purpose: a schema stands alone.
title: Wi-Fi access point
description: A Wi-Fi access point, or a router with Wi-Fi: the network, the device and its admin login.

wifi_security.description: How the network is secured. Empty means not recorded.

wifi_key.description: Wi-Fi password. Empty for an open or an enterprise network.

URL.description: The admin web interface. Often a local http:// address, which is a valid address.

UserName.description: The user name of the admin login.

Password.description: The password of the admin login. A fresh device may have none yet.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid. Empty means it does not expire.

else.description: A secured network, or one whose security is not recorded, has a key.

allOf.description: The admin login is recorded: where it is, and who opens it.
